At UIE we implement Qlaas, which connects AI agents to the systems your teams already use. You decide what each agent can do, which decisions need approval and how to check the result.

For data & telecommunications teams, these are the three workflows we would look at first:

Data & telecommunications: where a pilot could start
  01: Fault coordination
  02: Remote-hands requests
  03: Service change administration

Our data & telecommunications page puts it like this: “Connect customer requests to network providers, service desks and field operations. Replace repeated status checks with a clear record of ownership, next action and outcome.” For each workflow it sets out the request, the work, who keeps authority and the evidence that closes the case. There is also a calculator for putting a value on the time at your own case volumes.
